source_boundary_notes: Age wording and intervals are source-specific; no numerical age/ECOG eligibility invented.
Counts require ANC >=0.75 and platelets >=100; source late-recovery day is 22. Recovery never resets prior reductions.
General no-re-escalation wording conflicts with etoposide renal increase-if-tolerated text.
Mucositis table phase/occurrence mapping remains visually unverified; all modifications require specialist reconciliation.
Etoposide <10, doxorubicin exact CrCl10, hepatic decimal bands and cyclophosphamide CrCl29–30 require explicit review.
Vincristine product uses direct bilirubin; NCCP fraction unspecified. Product and regimen fertility intervals need whole-regimen reconciliation.
Mesna, hydration, G-CSF and methylene-blue plans are support prescriptions, never automatically calculated or stopped by cytotoxic holds.

eligibility: Adolescent/young-adult source population and national indication a/b; no numerical age cutoff provided.
Normal baseline renal, cardiac and hepatic function; consultant-initiated plan.
No numerical ECOG threshold is specified in these source eligibility sections.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to the named regimen medicines, mesna or excipients.
Product-specific contraindications require review, including vincristine demyelinating Charcot-Marie-Tooth syndrome and untreated infection.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, liver/renal profile, sodium, potassium and phosphate. Cardiac ECHO/MUGA when clinically indicated; source LVEF must be >50% for doxorubicin.
FBC/liver/renal profile before each cycle; sodium/potassium/phosphate before IE. Neurological examination before every ifosfamide dose; haematuria before each dose and every8 hours on treatment days.

Hospital fluid balance and daily weights; urine output target >=100 mL/hour. Review positive balance >1000 mL or weight rise >1kg. Hydration starts before ifosfamide and continues24 hours after completion.
Assess current/prior neuropathy, mucositis phase/occurrences, dose history, radiation timing and cumulative anthracycline exposure. Disease assessment according to consultant treatment plan.
dose_modifications: Age wording and intervals are source-specific; no numerical age/ECOG eligibility invented.
Counts require ANC >=0.75 and platelets >=100; source late-recovery day is 22. Recovery never resets prior reductions.
General no-re-escalation wording conflicts with etoposide renal increase-if-tolerated text.
Mucositis table phase/occurrence mapping remains visually unverified; all modifications require specialist reconciliation.
Etoposide <10, doxorubicin exact CrCl10, hepatic decimal bands and cyclophosphamide CrCl29–30 require explicit review.
Vincristine product uses direct bilirubin; NCCP fraction unspecified. Product and regimen fertility intervals need whole-regimen reconciliation.
Mesna, hydration, G-CSF and methylene-blue plans are support prescriptions, never automatically calculated or stopped by cytotoxic holds.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
additional_supportive_care: Both IE and VAC/VC have high overall emetic risk; review aprepitant interaction with ifosfamide/vincristine.

IE mesna and hospital hydration mandatory; mesna protects bladder but does not eliminate brain/kidney toxicity.

Source suggests increased fluid intake2–3 litres on cyclophosphamide Day1; individualise for renal/cardiac/fluid restrictions and the hospital plan.
Ifosfamide neurotoxicity rescue/rechallenge, methylene blue and potential substitution require specialist prescribing; no automated rescue dose.
Discuss fertility preservation and whole-regimen contraception/breastfeeding intervals; current vincristine product intervals differ from the NCCP 6-month general paragraph.
